document.title: Synthetic API/state fixture, not an approved RTOS interface

parameters.name: state
parameters.ownership: Caller-owned, valid writable nonoverlapping storage. Initial last_sample=0 and has_sample=0.

parameters.name: out_sample
parameters.ownership: Caller-owned writable int, disjoint from state.

return_codes.0: Read succeeded and both outputs updated.
return_codes.-1: A pointer was null; no API call or writes.
return_codes.-2: Synthetic API failed; preserve state and output.

external_api.name: Project_ReadSample
external_api.contract: FIXTURE ONLY. Supplied header/mock model a bounded immediate call: returns 0 and writes an arbitrary representable int on success; nonzero on failure, with output unspecified. Call exactly once after pointer validation. No allocation, blocking, lock, or real device access is modeled.

steps: If either pointer is null, return -1 without API calls or writes.
Call the supplied API once using a local temporary sample.
On nonzero API status, return -2 without writing state or out_sample.
On API success, set state.last_sample to the sample, state.has_sample to 1, and out_sample to the sample; return 0.
behavior.ownership: Independent states may be used by independent callers; external API synchronization is outside this fixture.

constraints: Include only supplied contracts; do not invent a real RTOS API or DLL ABI.
Use no shared static state, loops, recursion, dynamic memory, or direct operating-system APIs.
